To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Atari Learning Environment (ALE) is a good benchmark for deep reinforcement learning, and that the representations learned by deep RL algorithms differ substantially.

(1) the performance and representation of deep RL agents trained in the Atari Learning Environment vary across algorithms and games, (2) the Atari Zoo framework provides a useful dataset and software package to study these differences, and (3), this framework is useful for understanding the performance and representation differences between different deep RL algorithms

(a) there are significant differences between algorithms in their performance and representations on Atari benchmarks, and (b) we have released an easy-to-use framework that enables the community to easily analyze such differences.
